_provenance.title: Modeling and Simulation Credibility Assessments of Musculoskeletal Computational Models for NASA Extravehicular Activity Applications
_provenance.required_level_not_transcribed: This paper publishes its SME-informed sufficiency thresholds only in Figures 3-5, as bar charts. The numbers are not in the text layer and were not read off the plots. A sibling paper in the same family (20240000233) states thresholds of 2 for data/input pedigree and code/solution verification and 3 for conceptual/referent validation, results uncertainty and robustness -- but those are that paper's thresholds for a different injury scenario, and importing them here would be fabrication, not transcription.
